articleTitle: A Random Forest Regression Model for Predicting Residual Stresses and Cutting Forces Introduced by Turning IN718 Alloy
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: Random Forest algorithm has been utilized in this paper for creating a regression model to predict residual stresses and cutting forces introduced by turning IN718 alloy. Residual stresses and cutting forces are crucial to deformations of thin walled parts. Meanwhile, it is difficult to determine a specific regression equation expression between the dependent variables (surface residual stresses, max compressive residual stresses, cutting forces) and independent variables (depth of cut, feed rate, cutting speed). Random forest algorithm has the superiority as it can build regression relation between variables using many regression trees rather than a specific equation. Multiple sets of simulations were finished by the finite element method to obtain the regression training data. A series of turning and residual stresses measurement experiments with different turning parameters were conducted to ensure the accuracy of the regression training data. From the research, predicted residual stresses and cutting forces were consistent with simulation results, and the prediction errors were controlled within the acceptable range. The research could contribute the further investigation of thin-walled part deformation control.

articleTitle: Human Motion Recognition Based on Improved 3-Dimensional Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: In recent years, deep Convolutional neural networks(CNNs) have made fantastic progress in static image recognition, but the ability to model motion information on behavioral video is weak. Therefore, our paper put forward a new time transition layer that models variable temporal convolution kernel depths. We embed this new Hybrid Model in our proposed 3D CNN. We extend the DenseNet architecture with 3D filters and pooling kernels. It will take time as training a 3D convolutional neural network requires a large number of tagged data sets to start training from the input. Therefore, the focus of this paper is on simple and effective technique of passing 2D convolutional neural network pre-trained data to a randomly initialized 3D convolutional neural network for stable weight initialization, where we can still achieve our experimental results by appropriately reducing the number of 3D convolutional neural network training samples. Experiments show that the network can make a more accurate classification of behavioral video, identify it in the UCF-101 database, and compare it with other classical algorithms that have appeared in recent years. The results reflect the superiority of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of SAE J1939 Vehicle Diagnostics System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: Driving safety is always the top priority of fleet management for light duty (LD) vehicles. Unfortunately, the current bus driving recorder cannot be manipulated electronically. That is, the data plotted on the traditional pie chart is not digital and cannot be used for vehicle accident verdict. In this paper, a vehicle diagnostics system is developed based on the SAE J1939 protocol, which is developed by the Society of Automotive Engineers (SAE), for HD vehicles. In this system, an integrated software and hardware interfaces are implemented to monitor the vehicles relevant data. The Vector CANoe simulator is utilized to simulate the proposed Electrical Control Unit (ECU) in an automotive CAN bus environment. In this work, RL78 MCU from Renesas Electronics of Japan is used to design a monitoring device that supports SAE. With the proposed system J1939 Bridge, the driver data from the vehicle CAN bus can be monitored, analyzed and calculated. It can yield a range of insights about drivers' behaviour. The accessed data can also be displayed on a specific LCD screen connected to the system. Besides, data can be transmitted to other devices for mobile application via Bluetooth connection. The J1939 Bridge, presented in this paper, is jointly developed by STUST University and SwiSys Company in Taiwan.

articleTitle: Investigation into Ergonomics in Logistics Sorting Equipment
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: This paper aims to improve the working efficiency and workers' comfort by designing the operation and logistics sorting equipment. First of all, the device evaluation was carried out in the form of questionnaire and interview for on-the-job Courier sorting workers. Secondly, Ovako Working Posture Analysis System (OWAS) was adopted to analyze workers' operating Posture. Considering the types, function, frequency of use, function and order of use of devices, each device is put in the optimal position according to ergonomics principle, and the size of these devices conforms to the relevant regulations of adult human body size. A computer-aided ergonomics analysis software Jack is introduced to create a digital human model and a logistics sorting operation system. The simulation is carried out to evaluate the design scheme in terms of human comfort and sorting efficiency, and an ergonomic work system is proposed.

articleTitle: Prediction of Casing Damage in Unconsolidated Sandstone Reservoirs Using Machine Learning Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: Despite numerous studies in the subject matter, there is no mature casing damage prediction method based on historical casing damage data in the oil and water well production stage for unconsolidated sandstone reservoirs. We use two popular algorithms to establish a prediction model for the sand-sand casing damage area, eXtreme Gradient Boosted Trees (XGBoost) and Light Gradient Boosted Trees (LGBM). According to data analysis and casing damage mechanism, we selected 19 casing damage factors for oil wells and 18 for water injection wells. Geological, reservoir, completion and historical production/operation data for 653 production layers and 212 injection layers in Gangxi Oilfield are collected to form dataset. Among them, the casings of 91 production layers and 22 injection layers were damaged. The dataset is split into 80% training and 20% holdout datasets. A training dataset is split into 10-fold cross validation. Two machine learning algorithms are evaluated predicting casing damage and their performance is compared. For production wells, the prediction accuracy of LGBM model is higher, up to 95.4%. For injection wells, the prediction accuracy of LGBM model is higher, up to 100%. Therefore, we can use more accurate model to predict casing damage in unconsolidated sandstone reservoirs, and determine main controllable factors of casing damage in risk wells, so as to provide technical guidance for technicians to take preventive measures.

articleTitle: ECG Automatic Identification Method based on BP Neural
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: Cardiovascular diseases are one of the common diseases that threaten human health. The classification and identification of abnormal rhythms in ECG is essential to improve the successful cure rate of patients. Therefore, an automatic ECG recognition method based on BP neural network is proposed. Firstly, the electrocardiogram is de-dried by using the bior wavelet to eliminate the baseline drift and high-frequency noise of the ECG. Then, the QRS and TP waves are detected by the double-spline wavelet, and their 6 amplitude features and 15 distance features are extracted. Finally, the optimal BP neural network model is selected to identify the ECG signals. The experimental results show that the correct rate of classification and recognition of ECG signals is more than 99%, and the correct recognition of Type 5 is greatly improved, and it is better than SVM and convolutional neural network.

articleTitle: Based on Public Health Service in Smart Medical Comprehensive Service Platform
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: In recent years, as science and technology have been continuously improving with rapid developing information technology, China has become more prosperous and healthy. However, there are always many problems in the field of medical and health care in China. Medical resources are scarce and unreasonable, and mainly concentrated in large cities and the top three hospitals. The resources of public health services are weak, too. The quality of medical care is low, accidents are frequent, and patient safety is difficult to guarantee. Expensive medical expenses are unbearable for patients. In response to the above problems, we will propose the Internet as a carrier and information technology such as mobile Internet technology,cloud computing, Internet of Things, Big Data, etc., as means to create an integrated service platform. Realization of medical technology, medical practice, medical equipment, social capital, pharmaceutical equipment, etc. from grassroots level, medical and health services, and management to t e home can be improved by the ability of public health care services. It is needed to consolidate the grassroots foundation of grading diagnosis and treatment, and provide a quantitative management platform for the government to manage grassroots health effectively. This study provides a precise service platform for grassroots health stations to serve and an efficient, intelligent platform for ordinary people's health management and seeking medical care.

articleTitle: Solving Maze Problem with Reinforcement Learning by a Mobile Robot
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: Reinforcement learning has been applied to mobile robot control in various domains. In principle, mobile robots can learn through reinforcement learning, but sometimes it can be very time consuming when learning complex tasks. In this paper, three solution algorithms that can be used in the maze problem are introduced. In this paper, we also introduce important mathematical equations in these algorithms.

articleTitle: Detection of Exercise Fatigue Using Neural Network with Grey Relational Analysis from HRV Signal
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: This paper proposes an exercise fatigue detection model based on real-time physiological data, combined with time-domain analysis (time-domain analysis), frequency domain analysis (frequency domain analysis), trend analysis (trend wave analysis, DFA), approximate entropy (Approximate entropy, ApEn) and sample entropy (sample entropy, SampEn). As a result, this research also presented a feature selection with the Analytical hierarchy process (GRA), which extracted vital impact factors. Finally, the Back-propagation Neural Network (BPNN) is used to analyze each data feature to identify the individual’s exercise fatigue. According to the empirical results, the exercise fatigue detection model proposed in this study can effectively distinguish the degree of exercise fatigue and improve the accuracy to a satisfactory level.

articleTitle: Indoor Parking Navigation System Using Visible LED Light Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: In recent years, visible light communication technology has been widely used in indoor positioning since GPS navigation often cannot work normally indoor and it is difficult for car owners to find a parking space. The use of LED light source for address coding can realize indoor positioning navigation. According to the actual situation of the indoor parking lot, the infrared sensor, PIN photoelectric sensor, Zigbee communication and Bluetooth communication are comprehensively utilized to realize the intelligent positioning navigation function. The reliability of the system has been verified by the parking lot model: the infrared sensor can detect the parking space information in real time; then, the server sends the information to the LED lighting fixture through Zigbee communication; next, the lighting fixture modulates the address and parking space information into the LED light through OOK code; last, the receiver receives the LED light through the PIN photoelectric sensor, and after decoding, the information is sent to the client through the Bluetooth and the client uses the received information to realize the positioning navigation.

articleTitle: Development of digital mine information platform based on Internet of things technology
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: Digital mine is the core content of mine industry informatization. According to the life cycle theory of software engineering, this paper studied the digital mine construction of Internet of things and big data as the core technology. Firstly, this paper starts with the main functions of mine production planning and production scheduling, analyzes the general demands of digital mines in detail, then designs the physical platform architecture and functional architecture of digital mines, and finally verifies the effectiveness of the analysis and design process through examples.

articleTitle: A Trend based Forecasting Model Using Fuzzy Time Series and PSO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: Time series prediction methods are vital in many areas, such as science, meteorology, agriculture, stock indices, economics, etc. To improve the forecasting accuracy, fuzzy approaches and evolutionary methods are widely used in time series forecasting models in recent years. Therefore, a hybrid method based on fuzzy time series and particle swarm optimization algorithm is proposed to establish a forecasting model. This study considers the scenario using the trend-based weighted strategy in hybrid fuzzy PSO model (THFPSO) to estimate the unknown future values. The export orders index (EOI) data of Taiwan are selected as the experimental dataset. The experimental results show that the proposed model can reduce the mean square error (RMSE) and improve accuracy comparing with other models based on fuzzy time series.

articleTitle: Human Activity Recognition Based on Loss-Net Fusion Domain Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: Human activity recognition is now a hot issue in artificial intelligence research. The purpose of activity recognition is to analyze behaviors in an unknown video or image sequence by computer. Unlike previous static recognition, the challenge of behavior recognition is how to capture motions between still frames. For reports of Convolutional Neural Network(CNN) architecture in the past, we used a method of implicitly capturing motion information between adjacent frames to improve the CNN architecture, taking the original video frames as input and predicting the action class without explicit optical action class calculation directly. Our architecture was trained and tested using videos from the UCF-101 human behavior database and achieved very ideal results.

articleTitle: Effect analysis of grinding wheel under different dressing parameters on surface grinding quality
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: The grinding wheel dressing experiments and the slider grinding experiments were carried out in this paper. The surface topography of the alumina wheel before and after grinding, and the morphology of the slider raceway were obtained by a 3D surface morphology instrument. An image processing method was employed to measure the surface roughness of slider raceway and wheel surface morphology. Under the same grinding parameters, the influence of alumina grinding wheels obtained under different dressing parameters on the surface quality was analyzed.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Dumbbell Designed for Fitness Activity Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: As a small fitness equipment, dumbbells are suitable for people of different ages, genders and physiques. In order to increase the fun of dumbbell fitness and realize the monitoring and guidance of dumbbell fitness exercise, this paper designs an intelligent dumbbell based on acceleration sensor and wireless communication technology. The intelligent dumbbell collects motion information through acceleration sensor and transmits it by wireless communication modules after processing by microprocessor. The mobile phone receives the processed motion information, which realizes the intelligent monitoring of the dumbbell fitness. The user can also set the fitness mode through mobile phone to guide the user fitness and achieve the purpose of scientific fitness.

articleTitle: An improved adaptive firefly algorithm for PI parameter optimization of permanent magnet synchronous motor
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: A parameter optimization algorithm for the PI controller of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) based on improved adaptive firefly algorithm (IAFA) is proposed. The PI parameters of current and speed are set by improved adaptive firefly algorithm. This paper introduces 7 dimensions firefly population and adaptive step adjustment mechanism in the algorithm, which is fast and convenient to obtain the optimal solution accurately. The traditional parameter optimization method usually uses an operator to get the target parameter after repeated debugging in the actual system, which is inefficient and relies heavily on production experience. In order to optimize this problem, multidimensional population and adaptive step adjustment strategy are proposed to speed up the iteration and get the global optimal. The results demonstrate that PMSM-IAFA has fast convergence rate and high computational accuracy. It significantly outperforms the other state-of-the-art FA variants in majority of the tested instances.

articleTitle: Employed the Fingerprint Recognition Technology to Manage Smart Warehouse
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: We used the technology of fingerprint identification to monitor and manage the despondence information and data of warehouse. As for the warehouse environment's temperature and humidity that can too be real-time monitored to ensure the quality of goods. We also proposed an innovative and practical monitoring method that can be used in warehouse whose space is up to 100 square meters. The administrators can instantly know the status of the warehouse through the mobile devices. The results of experiments, the accuracy of fingerprint analysis shows the fingerprint identification to be suitable to the access control mechanism of warehouse.

articleTitle: Anylazing and Selecting of DC-link Capacitor of Novel Three-phase AC-DC-AC Converter
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: The three- phase AC-DC-AC converter with thin-film capacitance is required to reduce capacitance to enhance the power density of the device. A novel three-phase AC-DC-AC without or with a quite small DC-link capacitor based on improving modulation wave reconstruction technology is proposed. Accordingly, work principle and switch mode under resist and reactive load is analyzed, and modes of “refluent” current produced by A-phase-bridge of three-phase AC-DC-AC with reactive load are expounded in detail. On the basis of analysis results, the selecting method of the DC capacitor of novel inverter is given. The results verify the feasibility of selection the minimum DC capacitor scheme based on “refluent” current.

articleTitle: On Performance Analysis of LSU-EKF Parameter Estimation Method for Polynomial Phase Signal
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: In this paper, performance analysis of the LSU-EKF estimator, which proposed in our previous work, is conducted in detail. In the proposed method, the coarse parameter estimates of PPS are achieved through the LSU estimator with a few samples. However, these coarse estimates are for the purpose of initializing the EKF. Monte-Carlo simulations obviously show that the computation complexity of the LSU-EKF estimator is much less than that of the LSU estimator, with very small performance loss. Like the LSU estimator, the proposed algorithm is capable of working over the entire identifiable region. In addition, in the EKF process, the accurate estimated results can be output point-by-point, which can be useful in practical applications.

articleTitle: Closed Form Solutions to Displacement and Stress on Functionally Graded Rotating Disk with Exponentially-Varying Material Properties and Thickness
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: In this paper, analytical solutions for displacement and stresses in thin-walled functionally graded material rotating disk with variable thickness subjected to internal and external pressure are obtained using the infinitesimal theory of elasticity. The material properties and thickness of rotating disk are assumed to be exponentially-varying in the radial direction. The governing differential equation in radial displacement is solved in terms of generalized confluent hypergeometric equation. The effects of mechanical load on displacement and stresses are graphically presented.

articleTitle: The Study of Cooperative Diversity Scheme for Indoor Visible Light Communication
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: In this paper, we proposed an indoor cooperative diversity scheme based on space-time labeling for visible light communication (VLC) to resist the channel fading and improve the system performance. This re-adjusted constellation at the relay node in order to magnify the distance product of the corresponding constellation points which are the source node and the relay node to improve diversity gain. The system model of this scheme and the detailed signals processing were presented. Numerical results showed that the proposed scheme had a significant performance improvement in bit error rate (BER) compared with conventional cooperative diversity scheme based on the repetition coding for indoor cooperative VLC.

articleTitle: Screening Tracking Algorithm based on Ultra-Wideband Sensor for AGV tracking
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: This paper proposes a screening tracking algorithm based on ultra-wideband sensor. In view of the uncertain location results near the anchor nodes and the specific occlusion area in the Time Difference of Arrival location method of three anchor nodes, the proposed algorithm adopts indoor environment information and AGV motion state information to filter location results and aided in reducing the probability of location errors, in which the AGV motion state information comes from tracking algorithm. The simulation results demonstrate that the algorithm in this paper has a high probability of correct location and can effectively track and locate Automated Guided Vehicle under the condition of three anchor nodes.

articleTitle: A kind of IFS fractal image generation method based on Markov random process
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: In order to strengthen the IFS fractal attractor image to control the shape effectively, based on the standard iteration function system, and by introducing the double random process of hidden Markov model, the standard iteration function system better controllability parameter model has established and, can be in control graph shape modeling. Markov random process is used to impose parameter perturbation on affine transformation family, and then a control method of iterated function system fractal image generation is proposed. The examples are provided, which indicates that this method can draw shapes with a variety of fractal images.

articleTitle: Problems of creation and usage of 3D model of structures
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: The paper deals with problems commonly encountered in geodetic surveying of buildings and subsequent 3D model creation in suitable softwares (e.g. CAD systems). It is mainly a relatively high proportion of manual work when connecting individual points, approximating curves and surfaces or laying textures on surfaces. In some cases, it is necessary to generalize the model in the CAD system, which degrades the accuracy and quality of field data. The article analyzes these problems and recommends several variants for their solution. There are described two basic methods: using topological codes in list of coordinate's points and creating new special CAD features using Python scripts. The article includes examples of selected 3D models realized by the authors and the problems of the reverse engineering is demonstrated

articleTitle: A Survey on Default Prediction of Cloud Storage Service
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: The opacity promotes the extensiveness of cloud storage resources, while it wears the trust of users in cloud storage resources on the other hand. In the event of a default in cloud storage services, predicting the possibility of cloud storage default by dynamic comparison of storage system situation and time-varying storage SLA. This paper first reviews the research status of cloud storage services default and its prediction; Secondly, summarizes the classification of cloud storage malfunction and its prediction; Thirdly, analyzes the essential difference between failure/fault prediction and default prediction, and then clarify that the existing results of failure/fault prediction are difficult to directly apply to the prediction research of cloud storage services default; Finally, suggests on the research approach of cloud storage default prediction are given.

articleTitle: Frequency-dependent oscillating wall stirrer for measurement of quality factor in a reverberation chamber
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: As a key parameter, the quality value (Q value) performs an important role in reverberation chamber validation progress. The Oscillating wall stirrer (OWS), as a quasi-wall, manifests well performance especially near the lowest usable frequency (LUF), which may change the Q value during the stirring progress. Unlike the traditional stirrer, the OWS oscillates rather than rotates on the stirring process, which brings the volume a variable to the estimation. In this paper, measurement for the Q value concentrates on frequency-domain and the frequency-stirred method has been carried out. Twelve typical stirring positions of Q values have been presented to investigate whether the OWS changes Q value. The measurement uncertainty of the results with and without the stirring progress has been compared to reveal the relationship between the Q factor and the movement of OWS.

articleTitle: Design of a Low-power Single-channel 8-Bit 1.25GSPS SAR ADC
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: Successive approximation register analog to digital converter (SAR ADC) has incomparable energy efficiency advantages over other types of ADC architectures for its high degree of digitalization and simple structure. Undergoing algorithm verification with MATLAB, a single-channel 8-bit 1.25GSPS SAR ADC structure is presented. Transistors level circuit has been designed using TSMC 28nm CMOS technology. The pre-simulation results with noise show that the core circuit has the ENOB 7.80bits, the power consumption 2.01mW, and the FOM value 6.29fJ/conv-step when operating at very high speed with sampling rate of 1.25GSPS under 1.2V supply.

articleTitle: Design of Optical Sensing System for Intravenous Drip Measurement
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: In this paper, the optical design of the IV drip was designed with the following techniques: A light sensing module mainly set for detecting the height of the liquid levels in injection drop bottles or the drip bags to find out if the drop bottle (bag) is empty. The light from the solid-state light source passes through the titration chamber with or without drip, and then the light is received by the photoresistor, in order to make the light of the solid-state light source more concentrated. The titration chamber of the drip liquid is then passed to the receiving surface of the CdS, and the focus lens is optimized and this verification is achieved via the TracePro optical software.

articleTitle: Sculpture Design using 3D VR Technology with an Example of Nanjing Jiangbei New District
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: Three-dimensional software and interaction technique of computer are utilized for three-dimensional virtual sculptures, which changes traditional methods and shows its superiority in many aspects. Three-dimensional virtual technology has provided a set of efficient, multi-perspective and convenient-for-redesign new thoughts for sculpture design. This paper conducts analysis through a sculpture in Nanjing Jiangbei New District, and systematically combs new thoughts for sculpture creation in combination with the creation conception of MAYA modeling and rendering. This has a certain referential significance on digital sculpture design at present.

articleTitle: Empirical Research on Soybean Futures Option Pricing Based on Weighted Least Squares Quasi-Monte Carlo
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: Least Squares Monte Carlo (LSM) is widely used in American option pricing. The weighted least-squares quasi-Monte Carlo (WLSQM) method is obtained by using the randomized Sobol sequence combined with the control variates based on the LSM method. And use WLSQM method to analyze the option pricing of soybean meal futures First, the random Sobol sequence is used to simulate the price path of soybean meal futures. Second, the WLSQM method, after introducing the control variates, is used to calculate the price of soybean meal futures option. Finally, the validity and accuracy of the WLSQM method verified through the comparative analysis of the least-squares Monte Carlo method (LSM), the least-squares quasi-Monte Carlo (LSQM), and the actual data.

articleTitle: Human Motion Law Based Design and Control for Sit-to-Stand Assisting Devices
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: Sit-to-stand is an essential motion in daily life. As sit-to-stand motion deals with the transition from two stabilized postures, the coordination of body and the muscle strength of lower limb were highly required at same time. So it is difficult for the elderly and impaired people to complete sit-to-stand motion independently. Sit-to-stand rehabilitation training can improve the muscle strength of the elderly and impaired people, enhancing the coordination ability of the human body, and improving the ability of self-care. Sit-to-stand assisting devices are able to help elderly and impaired people better to complete sit-to-stand transfer and rehabilitation training in daily life, and relieve the work of caregiver. Because the whole body coordinated movement is needed in sit-to-stand motion, the trajectory planning of the end-effector of sit-to-stand assisting devices is very important for achieving the correct sit-to-stand motion posture. In this paper we detail a procedure for design and trajectory control for sit-to-stand assisting devices. Firstly, the experiment of sit-to-stand motion was carried out, and the trajectory and orientation of knee, hip and shoulder were monitored and acquired. Secondly, this paper summarizes the motion law of sit-to-stand motion, divides the process of sit-to-stand motion into four phases: initial, balance, rising and stable phase, and gives the motion trajectory of the end-effector for sit-to-stand assisting devices. Finally, the mechanism of sit-to-stand assisting devices is designed, and the mechatronic control system is constructed to control the sit-to-stand assisting devices.

articleTitle: The Performance of Grey Model and Auto-Regressive Integrated Moving Average for Human Resources Prediction in China
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: The human resource of planning involves using any number of sophisticated statistical procedures based on the analysis. At a more practical level, prediction demand involves determining the numbers and kinds of personnel that an organization will need at some point in the future. This research compared the forecasting performance between GM (1, 1), ARIMA, and GMARIMA to determine the best method to predict the number of Human Resources in China. The GM-ARIMA model is to establish a GM (1,1) model concerning the ARIMA model residual value and add the resulting residual prediction value to the original predicted value of the ARIMA model to compensate for the original predicted value and obtain GMARIMA model of the forecast results. Experimental results present that GM-ARIMA can be an effective way to improve prediction accuracy achieved by either of the models used separately.

articleTitle: Effect of multi-pass welding thermal circle on the mechanical properties of SAW joints with SUS316L
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: In this study, the analysis subject is SUS304 stainless steel plate jointed by submerge arc welding with a groove. A three dimension finite element method model is built to simulate the welding temperature field. The simulation result was verified by experiment. The size of heat affected zone, high temperature residence time and peak temperature were quantitatively studied. In addition to the aboves, the micro-structure and mechanical properties of different welding passes are examined and analyzed, too.

articleTitle: Energy Efficiency Improvement with Hydraulic Electric Hybrid Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: Hydraulic electric hybrid vehicle (HEHV) is designed, and its energy management control strategy is discussed in this paper. Matlab/Simulink is used to establish a battery electric vehicle (BEV) and HEHV models, and backward simulation is adopted for the simulation to get the variation of torque and battery state of charge (SOC) through New York City cycle of the US Environmental Protection Agency (NYCC). In this paper, the rule-based control strategy and the genetic algorithm are applied for the energy distribution management strategy. The simulation results show that the electricity economic performance of the designed hydraulic hybrid vehicle is improved by 43.65% than that of battery electric vehicle.

articleTitle: Effect of Transparent Capacitor on the Panel Uniformity of Bottom Emission AMOLED
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: In this paper, we performed optical and electrical simulation analysis on the transparent capacitive pixel of the bottom-emitting AMOLED. The results show that the Btm-ITO layer can obtain good transmittance when the thickness is less than 20 nm. And when the transparent capacitor is designed at the T1 gate, the effect of feedthrough on panel uniformity can be alleviated. Conversely, when Btm-ITO is designed for T1 source, the uniformity of panel will be reduced.

IEEE Keywords: Active matrix organic light emitting diodes

articleTitle: Prokaryotic Expression and Purification of LscW Protein of Lawsonia intracellularis for biomedical engineering
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: In order to study the LscW of Lawsonia intracellularis, the prokaryotic expression vector of LscW protein was constructed. Two primers were designed in this experiment. The 1197 bp lscW gene was amplified from L. intracellularis B3903 strain by PCR and inserted into pCold expression vector to construct recombinant plasmid pCold/lscW, which was transformed into BL21 competent cells. The positive clones were induced by IPTG, purified by protein purification column, and confirmed by SDS-PAGE gel electrophoresis. The LscW was expressed in the supernatant and purified to obtain a single target protein band.

articleTitle: Development of Virtual Tour Guide Integrating Instant Google Street Views
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: This paper develops a Virtual Tour Guide by integrating instant Google Street Views. Applying Micro Controller Unit (MCU) Arduino Uno, it is a practical integration between instant Google Street Views and sense circuit, which transforms user movements into digital data. With Virtual Tour Guide, users can virtually visit any tourist attractions, and experience instant street views without any obstacles and limitations of time, weather conditions, and costs.

articleTitle: Photo-volatic Systems on Rooftops of Buildings; Kaoshiung City’s Renewable Energy Endeavor
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: The Kaohsiung city government adopted an action with a series of policies to increase solar energy production. Firstly, it established an operating network by forming an inter-departmental task force to promote photovoltaic (PV) systems in the public and private sectors. It also linked professional organizations with local communities and set up a dedicated hotline for consultation and inquiries. Secondly, it strengthened its photovoltaic infrastructure through formal statutes and regulations. This includes the announcement of a series of official solar photovoltaic policies, the promulgation of a floor area ratio incentive, and the enforcement of mandatory policies to increase photovoltaic implementation. Thirdly, it designated target sites to serve as examples of the project. These include installing photovoltaic systems on public rooftops, building photovoltaic demonstration zones, transforming illegal structures into solar power providers, and assisting the fishing and agricultural sectors in building photovoltaic systems. This study looks at the evidence of achievements for which the city has promoted scientifically meaningful architectural aesthetics in its innovative green buildings and energy technology, as well as the success it has seen pushing the policies through a bottom-up structure. In conclusion, it can be said that, using a model based on a project developed by our institute, the Kaohsiung city government has successfully made the renewable energy become an integral part of Kaohsiung's lifestyle, creating a threefold win for the government, the institute, and the people of Kaohsiung.

articleTitle: A Survey on Tracing for Default of Cloud Service
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: After the default of cloud service, tracing can provide evidence for the final determination of responsibility attribution dispute. This paper surveys the research status of tracing towards cloud service accountability mechanism. This paper first reviews the research status of tracing; Secondly, summarizes the classification of cloud service default and its tracing; Thirdly, analyzes two essential differences between attack tracing and responsibility tracing, and then clarify that the existing results of tracing are difficult to directly apply to the tracing research of cloud services default; Finally, cloud service accountability is oriented to suggests on the research approach of default tracing are given.

articleTitle: Build-up of Data Analysis Protocol of Leaf Quality Index on Autotoxicity of Soil
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: In the paper, rhizosphere soils of the 6 Oolong tea plant with different ages were collected, and soil autotoxicity and effects of soil to leaf quality indexes of tea seedlings were measured. The results of soil autotoxicity showed that inhibition rates of soil to tea plant height raise as soil age increased, especially after 9 years, which increased significantly. Analysis results on leaf quality indexes of tea seedling showed that polyphenols, theanine and caffeine contents of the 6 tea leaves raise firstly, then fell as soil age increase, especially over 9 years, which declined significantly. Correlation Analysis results showed that autotoxity was positive with planting years of tea soil, and negative with the 3 quality indexes significantly. In conclusion, soil being planted for several years continuously had autotoxity to tea plant, and especially over 9-year-old soil, it had significant effects on leaf quality of tea seedling.

articleTitle: Artificial Dispatcher Based on Deep Learning and Expert System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: For an electric power system, the dispatchers play an important role. As dispatchers watch, command and control the whole system day and night, so they are tired easily. To become a qualified dispatcher, a man needs long-term training. Therefore, the idea that artificial dispatchers replace human being is attractive. The paper presents to design an artificial dispatcher based on deep learning and expert system. The artificial dispatcher includes three parts: speech recognition, semantic comprehension and text-to-speech engine. The speech recognition, based on a convolutional neural network (CNN), recognizes oral orders of higher-lever dispatcher or voice reports of field staff into text. The semantic comprehension, based on an expert system about electric power, achieves the intention in the text, making corresponding decisions. The text-to-speech engine translates the decisions into voice orders to send to corresponding staff.

articleTitle: MATLAB-based Multi-parameter Optimization of Bulk Current Injection Probe
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: Current injection probe plays an important role in BCI(bulk current injection) technology and other EMC(Electromagnetic Compatibility) test fields. An optimization method which combines MATLAB and electromagnetic simulation software CST is proposed. Besides the magnetic characteristics of ferrite cores, mechanical parameters such as the outer diameter of the probe cavity will affect the leakage inductance and parasitic capacitance, which in turn affects the insertion loss of the probe. The key mechanical parameters of probe are computed and optimized with the aid of the objective function in MATLAB. The CST Microwave Studio is employed in MATLAB to execute full-wave iterative analyses.Using the above method, the current injection probe in frequency range from 10 kHz to 400 MHz is designed. Simulation result indicates that the performance of the designed probe and its calibration fixture meet the requirement of standard.

articleTitle: The Design of Android Phone Remote Control Password Lock
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: In order to ensure the safety of the home, a remote control password lock based on android mobile phone is designed, which takes AT89S52 microcontroller as the main control chip, AT24C02 as the data storage unit, SMC1602A as the display unit, and C language programming. It is used to realize the communication between electronic password lock and mobile phone by Hc-05 Bluetooth module. The combination lock with password change function, can be done through the keyboard and mobile phone with two way password input and change. With the keyboard input password lock out and connection to the android mobile phone with the electronic lock, the safety of the bedroom can be effectively guaranteed, and especially can provide convenience.

articleTitle: The Gelfand-kirillov Dimension of Quantized enveloping Algebra of Uq(B2)
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: In this article, by using the method of calculating the Gelfand-Kirillov dimension given in [1] and the Groebner-Shirshov basis for quantized enveloping algebra of U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</sub>(B<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) given in [2], we study the problem of computing the Gelfand-Kirillov dimension of quantized enveloping algebra of U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</sub>(B<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>). The main conclusion we get in this paper is that the Gelfand-Kirillov dimension of quantized enveloping algebra of U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</sub>(B<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) is 10. We hope this result will provide some ideas to calculate the Gelfand-Kirillov dimension of quantized enveloping algebra of U<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</sub>(B<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">n</sub>).

articleTitle: Design for the Evaluation System of Interdisciplinary Innovation Capability Based on Bibliometrics
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: As the interdisciplinary innovation capability is of great importance in the contemporary academic research, it is difficult to know about the evaluation system of interdisciplinary innovation capability for contemporary bibliometrics. In this paper, on the basis of empirical research, and from the viewpoint of bibliometrics, taking the research of innovation capability in five disciplines as an example, an evaluation system of interdisciplinary innovation capability with strong professional and multidisciplinary interdisciplinary is designed in this paper.

articleTitle: The Research of Wireless Charger by Inductance of Induction Coil
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: In this paper, we surveyed the relation of a wireless charging and the number of inductance turns of induction coil to solve the problems of current wireless charging, such as space distance, charge amount, and charging time. For the charging efficiency, we analyzed the issued wireless charging through induction coil with different antenna shapes and lengths. We obtained the results from experiments that those inductance values of the institute antenna with circular or square at 20 laps was respectively 13.4μH and 9.87μH. We also compared with the exiting market selling wireless charger with 3mm distance and found the issued work having better performance showing that the power charging time is about 2-3 hours to be saved.

articleTitle: A Survey of Time-varying Structural Modeling to Accountable Cloud Services
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: Cloud service has the computing characteristics of self-organizing strain on demand, which is prone to failure or loss of responsibility in its extensive application. In the prediction or accountability of this, the modeling of cloud service structure becomes an insurmountable priority. This paper reviews the modeling of cloud service network architecture. It mainly includes: Firstly, the research status of cloud service structure modeling is analyzed and reviewed. Secondly, the classification of time-varying structure of cloud services and the classification of time-varying structure modeling methods are summarized as a whole. Thirdly, it points out the existing problems. Finally, for cloud service accountability, research approach of time-varying structure modeling is proposed.

articleTitle: Research on Ultrasonic Creeping Wave Probe of Support Porcelain Insulator
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: In order to detect post insulator and porcelain bushing with ultrasonic, according to the characteristics of insulator probe, creeping wave detection is recognized to be an effective detection method. However it is found that the probe creeping wave probe produced by using the theory of calculating wafer angle than 3 degrees or mistress degree angle both can produce similar creeping wave display. This paper studies the method of ultrasonic detection of creeping wave method of strut porcelain insulator.

articleTitle: Four slot dynamic binary search anti-collision Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: To improve the performance of the Radio Frequency Identification (RFID) system and the multi-tag collision problem, a new anti-collision building algorithm is proposed based on the dynamic frame time slot Aloha algorithm and the analysis of binary search and four-slot binary search. In the new algorithm, the reader stack is used to form a further search command; the response tag is divided into four subsets, and the data information is sent in four-time slots, and up to eight tags can be recognized in one search. Simulation results show that the new algorithm greatly reduces the search times and recognition time.

articleTitle: Applying a Computer-assisted Concept-mapping Approach to the Improvement of English Reading Comprehension
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: The current English reading teaching in Chinese senior high schools mainly employs traditional methods, which lead to students' negative attitudes towards English reading. In order to solve these learning problems, we applied computer-assisted concept-mapping approach and conducted experimental research in 2017 in a senior high school, China. One hundred and twelve first-year students participated in the project. The research results demonstrate that the computer-assisted concept-mapping approach enhances the students' attitudes toward English reading and their reading comprehension level.

articleTitle: Applying Virtual Reality to the Control System for Status Judgment and Arrangement of Workpiece
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: Traditionally, it would require operating personnel directly making correction on site when the production line appears to have problems or is broken. In the process, safety and distance factors might result in unnecessary danger or delayed recovery. The integration of virtual reality software with graphic monitoring is proposed in this study to achieve the idea of cyber-physical system, allowing operating personnel immediately dealing with problems in the centralized control center without going to the site. The stereo-model of equipment and the peripherals are first established, and then the model material is pasted for the combination. The model is further imported to the virtual reality, and the interactive human machine interface is established to integrate the virtual-reality machines with the physical ones for the synchronous action. The experiment proves that using the self-developed system for operating virtual-reality machines could effectively and synchronously control the functions of “automatic continuous”, “single continuous”, “stepping action”, and “reset” of physical machine.

articleTitle: Bionic optimization for Roller Crusher
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: In the current material processing industry, roller crusher is widely used in mining, construction materials and other industrial sectors because of its simple structure, wide application range with safe and reliable performance. It is mainly used for medium or fine crushing of ore. With the rudimentary knowledge of roller crusher and bionics principle, the crushing theory of roller crusher, the kinematics of the material and the grinding force are analyzed in this paper. Based on bionics principle, we carry out bionic design and three-dimensional modeling of the crushing roller structure. Applying the discrete element analysis method, the crushing mechanism of the roller crusher is analyzed and optimized using particle behavior analyzing and simulating software EDEM. By analyzing the property of the material in the crushing process, a particle model simulating the broken material is created, and through orthogonal experimental design, four important factors affecting the production efficiency are tested independently from any other; roller surface shape, roller skin material, gap between rollers, roller speed. Then, a parameter set to maximize the efficiency is obtained. On this basis, the structure of the roller crusher is optimized. Finally, the optimization results are verified by comparing and analyzing the different indicators before and after the structural change.

articleTitle: Effects of Computer Assisted Language Learning on Learner Autonomy
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: The research project aims to explore effects of computer-assisted English listening teaching on students' learner autonomy and how CALL-based teaching mode improves students' achievements. The experimental research was conducted in 2017 in China. The participants were 74 ninth-grade students from two parallel classes, the experimental class (EC) and the control class (CC). The mean scores of each question on learner autonomy in CC are all less than 2.5, which indicates both EC and CC students were at a low level of learner autonomy before the experiment. After the whole semester, the research results show that the EC students' autonomous learning abilities and English listening achievements are greatly improved. As a result, CALL-based teaching mode is more effective than the traditional one.

articleTitle: Optimal Design of Driving Simulator Scenario System Based on Speed Perception
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: Driving simulator is widely used for examining driver behavior, developing new vehicle safety systems and training for driving license. The external validity of a driving simulator is measured by the comparison of actual speed between simulation and real world. The objective of this study is to validate the speed perception of a typical driving simulator scenario system based on edge rate and optic flow rate, which mainly influence human's speed perception. In a driving simulator scenario system, we optimized the scenario system by adjusting density of road guardrail and density of dashed line. Results from all the experiments showed that each factor influencing speed perception could be optimized to polish up the driving simulator scenario system. The results of this paper could be applied to optimize driving simulator scenario system.

articleTitle: Study on Thermoelectric Conversion and Conjugate Heat Transfer for PCBA by Finite Element Analysis
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: In this study, the simulation parameters obtained from experiment were used to verify the heat transfer parameters of graphene thermal interface materials (TIMs) on a single chip. The optical and power parameters of the unfilled high-power commercial LED lighting are measured by using integrating sphere and power analyzer in order to establish a fast and accurate simulation mode. The heat dissipation effects of composite and multilayer graphene-made TIMs in a closed and compact space are investigated using the heat-radiating materials with different thermal emissivity. By applying the established simulation mode, the simulation error in the main heating source of the light-emitting diode is between 3% and 5%. The use of composite graphene-made TIMs in the LED device can effectively reduce the operating temperature of the PCBA in a closed and compact space. The experimental result of temperature drop of the chip is up to 6.8 ° C and the simulation result shows the temperature drop is up to 3.9°C.

articleTitle: Digitalization and Visual Platform Build-up of Traditional Handicraft Culture in Jiangsu Province
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: The new background of The Times puts forward new requirements and inspirations for Jiangsu traditional handicraft culture. In the background, gradual decline of traditional handicraft culture was depicted. It is based on the double attributes of visibility and invisibility of visual design, combining Jiangsu traditional handicraft culture inheritance with modern visual aesthetics. It analyzes some representative cases of traditional handicraft cultural brands in China, explores the ways and means of creating traditional handicraft brands in the new era. The inheritance and innovation of traditional handicrafts in Jiangsu need to take advantage of the emerging visual platform, strengthen the visibility of traditional handicraft culture, and enhance the emotional sustenance with the public. By creating brand image, it is demanded to design innovative products and expand new media propaganda to revive local handicraft culture in Jiangsu region. This will play a certain role in promoting the inheritance and international development of traditional handicraft culture in Jiangsu and even the whole country.

articleTitle: Evaluating DNS Vulnerability to Cache Injection
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: The Domain Name System (DNS) is one of the most fundamental components of the Internet-based applications. DNS cache injection is demonstrably the most prominent and dangerous threat on DNS. In this paper, we explore the vulnerability of cache strategy in DNS resolver and propose a novel approach to evaluate injection vulnerabilities that allows cache injection attacks. The proposed approach is validated and experimented with real DNS resolution platforms such as Google Public DNS, BIND and Unbound, which illustrates our approach effectiveness and can be applied on realistic attack scenario. We then explain the impact of the injection attacks on DNS resolution platforms and their implications for several defense strategies against cache injection attacks.We upload the source code of our work to Github, which can be access from: www.Github.com/DNSBIT/DNS-Cache-Injection.

articleTitle: Development of Somatosensory Interactive Game System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: This paper is to develop a somatosensory interactive game system, which allows users to enjoy the fun of the game, and can also promote the body's limbs activities, bringing sports and health care effects. In view of the traditional game operation interface buttons, such as a health disk or a mouse, most of them only use palm and fingers, causing a large number of limbs not to operate. In order to increase the fun of interaction and the somatosensory interface, it can bring more leisure fun and be expanded to achieve the effect of exercise or rehabilitation. The system uses a microcontroller (MCU) Arduino. Through the operation platform, the integrated sensor component allows the user to operate in the normal motion mode, obtain the sensor value on the platform, and convert this data into game operation instructions instead of the traditional operation. The operating platform for the experimental test is to use a bicycle. The game interface is to use the car, and the pedaling of the bicycle drives the picture in the game to increase the fun of the game.

articleTitle: Investigating Consumer’s Intention for Ride-sharing Economy through Data Analysis from Didi Chuxing
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: “Ride-sharing economy” and “sharing economy” are hot topics usually appearing in recent ten years. From Airbnb, Uber to Didi, Mobike, and from house sharing to bicycle and ride sharing, sharing economy has begun to touch various views of many consumers daily life. And ride-sharing economy is the best kind of sharing economy with development and application of Information and Communications Technologies (ICTs). ICTs has made advances at full speed, expanded its extent of influence constantly through connection with client-side mobile terminal, as well as accelerated development and increased influences of commercial application needs like social media, network community, electronic commerce, mobile commerce and Internet. Till now, Internet, social media and mobile commerce all closely correlate with users' life and become associated with each interpersonal network, but also lead to sense of alienation between users in real life of the people worldwide. Thus, the enterprise's managing directors urgently need to comprehend the links with users motivation, attitude, behavioral intention and requirement by users for sharing economy services, so as to take the preemptive marketing strategy and opportunities in future online sharing business development. This study is to examine the impacts of perceptions on convenience, reputation, social value, attitude and consumer behavioral intention to use a ride-sharing service. Accordingly, the research result was completed by survey data (N = 118) gathered from positive consumers who have taken part in ride-sharing service with Didi Chuxing in China. Next analysis with structural equation modeling (SEM) and confirmatory factor analysis (CFA) were carried out with SmartPLS 2.0, to prove if this online survey proof will become adequate for this arranged prototype. Finally, the outcomes of this research offer empirical verifications that convenience, reputation, social value and consumers' attitude influence the consumers' behavioral intention to take part in a ride-sharing service in sharing economy. All outcomes of the research with meanings for academic and practical research could be farther pondered in future.

articleTitle: The IR Drop Effect of 2T1C and 3T1C Driving Modes in Top Emission AMOLED
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: In order to select the driving mode of 3T1C pixel circuits in Top Emission AMOLED, we carried out simulation analysis on the panel uniformity of different IR drops driven by 2T1C and 3T1C, respectively. The simulation results show that under the 2T1C driver circuit, the VSS IR drop will seriously affect the uniformity of the panel. In the case of 3T1C, the effect of the VSS IR drop becomes small. This is mainly due to the fact that the source of T1 is held at the data writing stage in 3T1C mode.

IEEE Keywords: Active matrix organic light emitting diodes

articleTitle: Defect Detection of Third Party Payment Processes in Android Applications
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: Mobile payment becomes more and more popular, and the main way of mobile payment, third-party payment, still faces many security problems. Based on the mainstream Android platform, this paper studies the payment process of the third-party payment platform and analyzes the security defects and security problems that may occur when the application developers realize the third-party payment process. The paper tested the security defects through experiments, and the test results showed that the integration of third-party payment functions was relatively popular in applications, and many applications integrating third-party payment functions had different degrees of security defects.

articleTitle: Structure design of aluminum alloy solution furnace based on fluid-solid coupling numerical simulation
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: Solution furnace is one of the main equipment in the heat treatment process of aluminum alloy. The distribution of flow field and temperature field in solution furnace directly affect the heat treatment quality of alloy parts. In order to comprehensively consider the influence of flow channel structure, fan system and thermal insulation layer on the flow field and temperature field in the furnace during the design process of the solid solution furnace, the method of computational fluid dynamics is applied to carry out the fluid-solid coupling numerical simulation in the CFD software for the virtual design of the equipment. The accuracy of the model was verified by experiments, and the temperature uniformity in the solution furnace reached ± 5k.

articleTitle: Study on Profile of Laser Coaxial Powder Feeding Additive Manufacturing Based on the Contour-Like Method
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: Coaxial powder feeding laser additive manufacturing has the advantage of rapidly manufacturing complex structures, while quality during the forming process is sophisticated to control. With the aim to overcome the intrinsic defect and determine the appropriate processing parameters, this paper proposes a contour-like method (CLM) based on cellular automata(CA), and investigates the relationship between features that characterize structures by analyzing the profile of single-pass in experiments and the process parameters such as laser power, powder feeding and powder-energy ratio (PEr).

articleTitle: Data Analysis of Bioassay of tea plant soil on endogenous hormone of tea seedlings
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: Rhizosphere soils of the 6 tea plants with different ages were collected, and soil autotoxicity and effects of soil to endogenous hormone of tea seedlings were analyzed. The results of bioassays related to soil autotoxicity showed that inhibition rates of the 6 soil extraction to root length of receptors raise as soil age increased, especially after 9 years, which had increased significantly. Analysis results on content of endogenous hormone in tea seedling leaf showed that when the 6 tea soil age exceeded 9 years, inhibitory rate of soil to IAA and ZR, and promoting rate of soil to ABA to rise significantly as soil age increased. Correlation analysis results showed that autotoxity was positive with planting years of tea soil and contents of ABA in the leaf significantly. In conclusion, for the 6 tea cultivars, soil autotoxity increased with the increase of tea soil age, and controlled contents of endogenous hormone in tea seedling leaves. This confirmed soil autotoxity is an important aspect in the formation of continuous cropping obstacles in tea plantation.

articleTitle: Innovative Design with Database of factors for Modern Woodwork
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: This paper firstly proposes innovative design elements of modern woodwork connection form. Further, the innovative design methods of modern woodwork connection form are summarized through the case study, which include reconstructing structure and fusing structure, interacting with symbiotic materials and stimulating texture, emphasizing modularity and highlighting additional features, magnifying components and conveying rhythms.

articleTitle: Research on Tangential Stiffnesses Solution of Horizontal Lathe Joint Surfaces and Dynamic Stiffness Optimization of the Whole Lathe Based on Modal Test
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: This paper presents a method based on modal test to analyze and optimize the dynamic stiffness of horizontal lathe. Through the analysis of modal test results, it is found that the first-order and third-order modal natural modes of horizontal lathe can be expressed by the same 2-DOF model. The tangential stiffnesses of the joint surfaces connected with the lathe bases can be obtained by solving this model. The second-order mode is used to check the tangential stiffnesses, and the result shows that the 2-DOF model is accurate to some extent. By using this model, the first three natural frequencies can be easily solved, and then the sensitivity analysis of each of substructure stiffness can be carried out. The dynamic stiffness of the whole lathe can be effectively improved by optimizing substructure stiffnesses with high sensitivity. This method solves the problem that the traditional finite element method is difficult to accurately simulate the joint stiffness.

articleTitle: Driveline Vibration Reduction of Two-Mode Hybrid System
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: In order to achieve better performance of fuel consumption in hybrid vehicles, the internal combustion engine is controlled to operate in a better efficient zone, and often turn off and on during driving, coordinating with motors for power output. However, while starting engine or shifting the mode, the instantaneous large torque of engine may occur, which easily leads to a high vibration of the elastomer on the driveline. This research built a two-mode power-spit hybrid system model with elastomers by using MATLAB/Simulink. Pause cancelation (PC) and Proportional-Integral-Derivative Control (PID) were employed in this research. In the research results, in the two-mode hybrid system with engine damper, half-shaft, and tires, PC was able to mitigate the peak-to-peak value of half-shaft reaction torque by about 22.5%. However, the mitigation effect of PID and PC-PID was better than PC, and the mitigation effect was able to reach 40%. The vibration was also converged faster.

articleTitle: Real-Time Threshold Voltage and Mobility Compensation for Large-Size AMOLED Displays
publicationTitle: 2019 IEEE International Conference on Computation, Communication and Engineering (ICCCE)
abstract: A new real-time compensation method of threshold voltage (Vth) and mobility (μ) for large size AMOLED display named `linear charging sensing (LCS)' is proposed in this paper. This compensation method can accomplish the Vth and μ sensing within tens or hundreds microseconds which can realize the sensing for all the pixels of FHD (1920×1080) AMOLED display within one frame time. By simulation analysis, LCS compensation method is found to have high accuracy for V<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sub> sensing with an error of 0.07V for ΔV<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sub>=0.5V and no error for ΔV<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sub>=-0.5V. Verified in FHD AMOLED panel further, the proposed method improves image sticking and luminance uniformity significantly.

IEEE Keywords: Active matrix organic light emitting diodes
